Hello, Marion County! Looking for something fun and family
friendly to do this weekend? Come to the annual marathon
in downtown Clarke City. Everyone looks forward to this
event all year long, especially runners! ® This year's race
is very special: it's the fiftieth annual Clarke City marathon.
To celebrate this milestone, county officials will have free
souvenirs available at the finish line area. Please note:
marathon runners should be sure to arrive early in order to
get to the starting line before the race begins at 8 A.M.

past.

C) It has happened for 50 years.
